mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.room_no AS roomNo, r.status, r.is_hourly AS isHourly, r.room_type_id AS roomTypeId, rt.type_name AS roomTypeName, COALESCE(rp.price, rt.price) AS todayPrice, COALESCE(req.cnt, 0) AS demandCount FROM room r LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON rt.id = r.room_type_id LEFT JOIN room_price rp ON rp.room_type_id = r.room_type_id AND rp.price_date = #{date} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM room_req_log WHERE req_date = #{date} GROUP BY room_id ) req ON req.room_id = r.id WHERE r.active = 1 ORDER BY r.room_no
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_req_log (room_id, req_date, content) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{date}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, req_date AS reqDate, create_time AS createTime FROM room_req_log WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND req_date = #{date} ORDER BY create_time DESC
